purpose: Descriptive weighting/influence sensitivity of already saved external scores, not new independent validation
source_scope: All four sources remain in manuscript; quantitative weighting sensitivity focuses known Liverpool3GG+2peK groups
calculations: Average saved per-curve scores within each existing group; retain original five-group primary weights
Average existing group scores within GG/peK; report two-family equal weights as descriptive alternative estimand, not replacement primary endpoint
For CRPS compare full linear weight function R(w)=w*R_GG+(1-w)*R_peK, w in[0,1], analytic break-even against both fixed Gaussian baselines; no weight chosen to win
Delete one saved group aggregate at a time, recompute only arithmetic means; label influence arithmetic, not leave-one-out training or independent confirmation
Report marginal coverage,width,interval score and square root of weighted MSE consistently; no pooled-RMSE naming
No significance tests or exchangeability/batch/calibration guarantees; no post-test model tuning
manuscript_policy: New candidate only; original main/SI, all previous scores and Gitarchives retained. Include all external adverse sources and weighting reversal if any.
public_copy_note: Only the machine-specific input locator is replaced by a repository-relative locator. Original protocol SHA is retained below.
